name: Build & Bundle Integrity
details: Production standalone file ResQsphere-App.html exists and built cleanly (971384 bytes). Vite singlefile build completed with 0 errors.

name: Removal of "View Incident Details"
details: "View Incident Details" button, handlers, and dead state completely removed from DisasterMap and AuthorityPortal.

name: Removal of Risk Monitoring & Situation Overview
details: Risk Monitoring navigation, fake 14.85m river telemetry, and unsupported SITREP executive report completely excised from Authority portal.

name: Removal of Supabase Warning Label from UI
details: "Supabase: Unconfigured (Local Safety Mode)" label successfully removed from navbar header and Home UI.

name: Chatbot Complete Removal
details: Chatbot floating buttons, modals, and user entry points are completely absent from App component tree.

name: Top-Level Navigation Opens Overview
details: Clicking top-level portal navigation links resets sub-views: Citizen opens 'main' services, Authority opens 'overview' dashboard, Partner opens 'main' relief coordination.

name: Geocoding & Verified Coordinates Resolution
details: Geocoding service implements verified Indian location DB (Hyderabad 17.3850°N/78.4867°E, Chennai 13.0827°N/80.2707°E) with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, Indian bounding box validation, and zero random coordinate offsets.

name: Demo Mode Chennai Incident & Map Centering
details: Chennai flood incident (INC-2026-095) present with exact coordinates (13.0827, 80.2707). DisasterMap prioritizes explicit incident center and prevents device GPS from overriding demo scenario.

name: Live Mode vs Demo Mode Strict Data Isolation
details: Demo Mode operates purely in client-side state using INITIAL_DEMO_* seeds and never writes fictional records to Supabase tables. Live Mode performs actual Supabase operations and enforces user.id association.

name: Supabase Client & Environment Variables
details: Client code is correctly wired to import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY with project URL https://pnykpvjsxwyezvvvjqjf.supabase.co and storageKey 'resqsphere_auth_token'. VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY needs to be added into drill demo/.env.
manualSteps: Copy your Supabase anon public API key from your Supabase Dashboard (Settings -> API -> Project API keys -> 'anon public') and paste it into drill demo/.env as VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<key>.

name: Auth Registration, Sign-In, Logout & Session Restoration
details: Auth state manager implements supabase.auth.getSession() and onAuthStateChange() listener with token persistence ('resqsphere_auth_token') and user caching ('resqsphere_user') for persistent sessions across page reloads.

name: Role Permissions & Access Control Guarding
details: Role barriers enforced with exact required prompts. Citizen is blocked from Authority and Relief Partner portals. Relief Partner is blocked from Authority portal. Self-escalation blocked by server-side approval check.

name: Database Schema & Row Level Security (RLS) Definitions
details: All 7 required tables defined with strict RLS policies enabled. Citizen reports are private to authenticated owner, public can read verified incidents, authorities have broad operational write permissions, and allocate_relief_resource function guarantees atomic transactions.
manualSteps: Execute 'resqsphere-schema.sql' in the Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor if not already run.

name: Atomic Resource Deduction & Fulfillment Math
details: Resource deduction logic mathematically verified: Initial stock 280 - 9 fulfilled = 271 remaining available stock. Over-allocation check prevents over-committing. UI displays exact previous (280), allocated (9), and remaining (271) feedback.

name: Response Team Creation & Phone Validation
details: Add Response Team modal implemented with positive size validation, TRAI Indian mobile regex (+91/0 prefix, 10 digits starting with 6-9), agency selection, and atomic context update.
